verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents several set-based operations that act on many rows in one call. Predicate-based deletes like `table.delete("role = 'Traitor Knight'")` remove every matching row. SQL-expression column transforms compute a new column across the whole table. Multiple query vectors can be searched in one call, and branches support backfills and index rebuilds without disturbing production reads. missing for 10: explicit evidence of bulk update/upsert (merge-insert) and batch ingestion semantics, documentation depth beyond snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
